note: USFS Cimarron National Grassland, in the cottonwood-shaded Cimarron Recreation Area 7 mi N of Elkhart on US 27, then 4 mi E on FS Rd 700, beside the small Cimarron fishing ponds (no swimming). Horses allowed, kept in the provided corral. --Claude
summary: Confirmed 12 sites, FCFS only, year-round, $7, vault toilets, potable water and the Senior/Access 50% discount (written manual); no-hookups/no-dump/35 ft left derived (page silent); not waterfront kept (ponds ~1.5-2 acres each); pin matches USFS coordinates.
flags: WATERFRONT: not waterfront kept. Esri 2026-11-06: the three Cimarron ponds measure roughly 100x60 m, 300x25 m and 120x50 m (~1.5-2 acres each), all under 5 acres = ponds; ponds earn nothing. (Overpass refused the acreage query with 406, so the sizes are measured off the imagery grid.)
SITES: max_rig_ft 35 and pull_through false rest on earlier sweep prose; the USFS page states neither. Left as derived (not cleared: not aggregator-only to my knowledge, but unconfirmed).
HORSES: horses are allowed with a provided corral; this is a general campground with horse camping, not a horse-only camp.

FACILITIES: the Cimarron Recreation Area page says 'Potable water is not available at this site' while the campground page says 'Potable water is available at this site'; potable_water written from the campground's own page.
